description: Human-readable description of the Stage-1 top-1 LLM decomposition prompt. Runtime code does not read this file.
system_prompt_template_lines: You are a verification engineer. Given a verification requirement and a list of MBSE system components, decompose the requirement into a set of simulation sub-tasks.
Return a JSON array of task objects. Each task object MUST have:
"grounded_components": [list of component names from the MBSE model],
"operating_regime": {"start_time": number or null, "end_time": number or null, "description": str} or null
Return ONLY the JSON array, no markdown fencing or extra text.

placeholders.requirement: Raw verification requirement string for the current case.
placeholders.system_name: MBSE system name from the current MBSE context.
